li.label: an old adventurer's stories
li.description: An old adventurer sat up with us telling stories half the night. I believe about two thirds of them.

li.label: a quiet guest
li.description: A guest who never says a word is sitting by the fields. I went and sat near them for a while, and came back calmer than I went.

li.label: sat in silence with a stranger
li.description: I sat beside the silent guest for most of a day, and neither of us said a word. That night I slept straight through.

li.label: fitted with a new limb
li.description: The limb-maker fitted me with a new one. It isn't the one I lost, but it works, and I keep finding things I can do again.

li.label: the venture paid
li.description: The merchant came back with twice our silver, just as promised. I said it was a good deal.

li.label: conned
li.description: There was never any caravan. I shook the swindler's hand and watched our silver walk off down the road.

li.label: we sold a prisoner
li.description: We handed a prisoner over for silver to people who want them dead. They were a raider, but still.

li.label: left a wounded stranger
li.description: Someone was lying hurt out past the fields, and we walked away. I keep wondering if they made it.

li.label: peace with an old enemy
li.description: We paid for peace with people who used to raid us. It cost plenty, but I'll sleep better.

li.label: paid the lord's tithe
li.description: A lord we've never met sent a reeve, and we paid for land we cleared ourselves.

li.label: we owe no lord
li.description: The reeve came for a tithe and went home without it. This land is ours.

li.label: argued the reeve down
li.description: A reeve came with a ledger and a seal, and I argued the claim down to nothing, stone by stone.

li.label: warm water from the ground
li.description: Since the tremor, warm water comes up out of the ground near the colony. I went and put my hands in it.

li.label: the lightning tree
li.description: Lightning split the old tree, and we left it standing. It looks like it's been there forever, and now it's ours.

li.label: wild honey
li.description: There was wild honeycomb with supper. I ate mine slowly and licked the plate.

li.label: chased off by bees
li.description: I went to smoke out a wild swarm, and the swarm had other ideas. I ran the whole way back.

li.label: bees at work
li.description: We left the wild bees alone, and now I hear them working the flowers from morning to dusk.

li.label: forged a fallen star
li.description: A star fell out of the sky, and I made a blade of it. I don't expect to make anything better.

li.label: a star fell near us
li.description: A star came down out on our land, and it's still lying where it fell. I've been out to look at it twice.

li.label: followed the sign
li.description: The animal at the gate led me somewhere I'd never have found on my own. It was worth the walk.

li.label: we honored the sign
li.description: An animal stood at our gate at dawn, and we left it an offering. Things like that should be answered properly.

li.label: we hunted the sign
li.description: An animal came to our gate like it had something to tell us, and we hunted it. That can't be lucky.

li.label: paid for someone's silence
li.description: Someone recognized me from the old days, and the colony paid them to forget. I hate that it came to that.

li.label: my past got out
li.description: Word of what I used to be has gone round the neighbors. I left that life behind, and now it's following me again.

li.label: faced down my past
li.description: Someone came to squeeze me over the old days. I talked to them, face to face, and they left with nothing.

li.label: my old commander won
li.description: My old commander's campaign went well, and our supplies helped. I'd have liked to be there.

li.label: my old commander lost
li.description: The campaign went badly. I keep thinking about who was standing in the line this time.

li.label: a patient came back to thank me
li.description: Someone I treated years ago walked all this way to thank me. I'd forgotten the face. They hadn't forgotten mine.

li.label: an old map from before
li.description: I found an old map from my life before. I've unfolded it more often than I'll admit.

li.label: looked at my find with me
li.description: I found something and they looked at it with me all evening, and answered every question.

li.label: my treasure
li.description: I found something nobody else has, and I get to keep it. It's on the shelf over my bed.

li.label: they sold my find
li.description: I found it, and they sold it to a trader. It was mine.

li.label: a present from my animal
li.description: My animal brought me a present and laid it at my feet. I made a big fuss over it.
